summary.en: Clear AI-generation artifacts enabled across every pack: stray chatbot greetings, unfilled placeholders, raw Markdown pasted into Word/PowerPoint, and dead placeholder links/buttons in generated UI.
summary.zh: 所有规则包默认开启的明显 AI 残留硬伤：留在正文里的 AI 寒暄、未填占位符、贴进 Word/PPT 没渲染的裸 Markdown，以及 AI 网页里的空链接与假按钮。

patterns: \[(?:待补充|待填写|此处插入|占位符)\](?!\s*\()
(?:Click to add (?:title|subtitle|text)|单击此处添加(?:标题|副标题|文本))

message.en: Unfilled AI template placeholder or dummy copy.
message.zh: 存在未替换的模板占位符或测试假文。

deletionTest.en: Supply the real value before sending, or delete the unfinished line instead of leaving a bracketed marker.
deletionTest.zh: 发稿前填入真实信息，或者直接删掉这一句，不要留括号占位。

exemplar.bad: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways; p95 latency was [insert p95 latency].
exemplar.trap: Q3 settlement improved dramatically across 14 gateways.
exemplar.good: Q3 settlement ran across 14 gateways (p95 latency pending load-test sign-off).

note.en: State what is still pending or fill in the measured figure instead of leaving a bracket.
note.zh: 尚未测出的数据直说待补，或填入实测数值，不要留括号占位。

hit: 附录见【此处插入测试数据】。
本次灰度覆盖 [待填写] 个集群。
clean: Contact the on-call engineer before Friday.
Array indexing uses items[0] in JavaScript.
Read [Your First GitHub Commit](https://example.com/guide) before opening a PR.
已完成第 3 节压测记录。

patterns: (?:^|\n)\s*(?:Certainly|Sure|Absolutely|Of course|Happy to help|Glad to help)[!,.]?\s+(?:[Hh]ere(?:'s| is| are)|[Bb]elow is)\b
\bFeel free to (?:reach out|let me know|ask) if you (?:need|have) (?:anything|any (?:other |further )?questions)[!.]?
(?:^|\n)\s*以下是为您(?:整理|撰写|润色|生成|修改)的
(?:希望这对(?:你|您)有(?:所)?帮助|如果(?:你|您)(?:还有|需要)(?:任何|其他)?(?:问题|帮助)[，,]?请随时告诉我)[！!。.]?
作为一个?\s*AI(?:\s*语言模型|\s*助手)?

message.en: Unstripped chatbot wrapper sentence or AI search citation token.
message.zh: 残留未清理的 AI 对话寒暄壳或检索引用内部标记。

deletionTest.en: Delete the conversational wrapper or internal citation token completely; start at the actual subject.
deletionTest.zh: 直接删掉对话寒暄句或内部引用残迹，正文从实际内容开始。

exemplar.bad: Certainly! Here is the revised rollout note: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.trap: Cluster B isn't just migrating — it's entering a new chapter on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.
exemplar.good: Cluster B migrates on November 24 at 02:00 UTC.

note.en: Strip the chat preamble and leave the rollout note intact.
note.zh: 删去对话开场白，直接进入正题。

hit: Certainly! Here is the summary of Q2 churn.
Happy to help! Below is the updated RFC.
好的，以下是修改后的会议纪要：周三上线。
好的，以下是本周进展：接口延迟降到 120ms。
周二 10:00 切流。希望这对你有帮助！
以下是为您整理的会议纪要：周四发布。
Here is the revised launch note: deploys at 14:00 UTC.
作为一个 AI 助手，我建议先做灰度验证。
As an AI, I cannot verify live deployment pricing.
clean: Sure enough, the cache warmed within 40 seconds.
以下是本周进展：接口延迟降到 120ms。
The daemon monitors queue depth every 5 seconds.
The reviewer flagged the subtitle as an AI microcopy tic in the prototype.

message.en: Raw Markdown syntax (`**bold**` or `## heading`) pasted unrendered into Word or PowerPoint.
message.zh: Word 或 PowerPoint 文本中残留未渲染的原始 Markdown 标记（如 `**加粗**` 或 `## 标题`）。

deletionTest.en: Convert the raw asterisks or hash marks into native Word/PowerPoint formatting.
deletionTest.zh: 去掉原始星号或井号，改用 Word/PowerPoint 原生样式或加粗格式。

exemplar.bad: **Key Milestone**: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.
exemplar.trap: Key Milestone — a game-changing v0.2 parser ships Friday.
exemplar.good: Key Milestone: Ship v0.2 parser before Friday.

note.en: Apply native run bolding in DOCX/PPTX rather than pasting raw Markdown asterisks.
note.zh: 在 Office 文档中使用原生字体加粗，不保留裸露的星号。

message.en: Placeholder `href="#"` link, empty button, or unexplained disabled button typical of generated UI mockups.
message.zh: AI 生成网页常见的空跳转链接（`href="#"`）、空按钮或未说明原因的占位禁用按钮。

deletionTest.en: Wire the control to a real destination, explain why it is disabled via `title`/`aria-describedby`, or remove the fake button.
deletionTest.zh: 接上真实链接或交互，或者说明禁用原因；没做的功能直接删掉按钮。

note.en: Point links to real targets and drop placeholder buttons that do nothing.
note.zh: 链接指向真实地址，不要摆放点不动的假按钮。
